description: Live-DB verification: a NEW admissions behavioral suite (registered in LIVE_DB_SUITES) covering the full applicant→enrolled journey and every CRITICAL INVARIANT, plus extending the cross-tenant escape suite + its policy meta-test to all six new tables (five standard + append-only application_reviews). Depends on FEAT-003 (routes/services/seed) and FEAT-001/002 (schema/migration/catalogues applied).
steps: Create apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/admissions-behavioral.integration.test.ts (real withTenant, NO vi.mock('@campusgate/db')). Use the escape-setup appClient/adminClient + withTenant pattern under a distinct prefix (e.g. ADM_TEST_); seed + tear down its own institutions/users/campaigns.

Cover (design §11 / requirements AC): applicant onboarding via POST /api/admissions/register creates User + ACTIVE membership + APPLICANT role and NO StudentProfile, duplicate email → 409 (AC-16); officer-on-behalf POST /applications resolving/creating an applicant by email; full journey campaign→apply→documents→review→offer→accept→enroll.
Enroll CREATE path: new StudentProfile asserts semester=1, free-text program, departmentId from the program, resolved academicSessionId, exactly one Enrollment (AC-6).

Enroll LINK path (HEADLINE): a person who already has a StudentProfile in the institution → Enrollment links to it, NO second StudentProfile (AC-7). Wrong-person enrollmentNo (owned by a different User, not sharing the email) → 409, links nothing (AC-17). Re-enroll idempotency → 409, no second StudentProfile/Enrollment (AC-8).

State machine + guards: REJECTED/WITHDRAWN cannot enroll → 409 (AC-5); an illegal transition → 409 leaving status unchanged (AC-4); a direct staff PATCH /applications/:id/status → ACCEPTED → 409 (AC-19); offer decline/expire returns the application to ELIGIBLE and a replacement offer can be issued (AC-19); enroll with no resolvable intake session → 422 (AC-18).

Privacy + module gating: append-only ApplicationReview (UPDATE/DELETE rejected at the DB, AC-9); applicant ownership isolation (another applicant's/another tenant's application → not-found/forbidden, AC-3); every operational route → 403 when admissions is not ACTIVE for the institution and disabling preserves data (AC-10). Decision changes write admissions.* audit events (AC-15).

Extend apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts: add the six tables to RLS_TABLES; add application_reviews to EXPECTED_POLICIES (append-only SELECT + INSERT pair, no modify) and leave the other five to DEFAULT_POLICIES; extend SeededTenant + seedBothTenants + cleanup with Phase-6 rows (campaign, application, document, offer, enrollment) for tenants A and B — do NOT seed an application_reviews row into the shared setup (its trigger blocks the shared teardown; cover it in a self-contained case instead).

Extend apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts with a Phase-6 block: read escape, foreign-parent write escape, spoofed-tenant write escape, buggy-query backstop, and three-GUC-state fail-closed for the five mutable tables; plus a self-contained append-only case for application_reviews (insert OK; UPDATE and DELETE denied; scoped trigger-disable cleanup) modeled on the student_profile_history 3x case.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api` passes, including the new admissions-behavioral suite and the extended escape suite.

The headline LINK test proves no duplicate StudentProfile on enroll; the CREATE test proves exactly one StudentProfile + one Enrollment with the §4 column sources; re-enroll + wrong-person both 409 with no extra rows.

The escape suite covers all six new tables (read/foreign-parent/spoof/buggy-query/fail-closed) and asserts application_reviews is append-only (UPDATE/DELETE denied) with its policy pair in EXPECTED_POLICIES.
The fast run (`npm test -w @campusgate/api`) stays green and still excludes the live-DB suites.
verification: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate status
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. Fast run (npm test -w @campusgate/api) = 40 files / 382 tests pass, and STILL excludes the live-DB suites (the new admissions-behavioral suite is in LIVE_DB_SUITES, so vitest.config.ts's default run never picks it up). Combined live-DB run (npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api) = 9 files / 126 tests ALL PASS, including the new admissions-behavioral suite + the extended escape suite. prisma migrate status (packages/db) = 'Database schema is up to date!' (12 migrations, unchanged). NOTE on flakiness: the shared free-tier Supabase pooler (<=15 clients, ap-south-1) intermittently drops a connection mid-run across 8 serial suites (P1001 'Can't reach database server :6543' / 'Transaction not found'); two such transient drops appeared in an earlier combined run on PRE-EXISTING escape tests (3h institution_modules, 3jl attendance) — NOT logic failures. Each suite is green in isolation (tenant-escape 60/60; admissions-behavioral 15/15) and the final combined run was fully green 126/126.

NEW SUITE: apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/admissions-behavioral.integration.test.ts (real Fastify app + real `authenticate` + real admissionsRoutes + real withTenant/RLS; NO vi.mock('@campusgate/db')). Registered in apps/api/vitest.live-db-suites.ts as 'src/**/admissions-behavioral.integration.test.ts'. SELF-CONTAINED under prefix ADM_TEST_: seeds two tenants (instA primary + instB foil), an ADMISSION_OFFICER + ADMIN + two programs + one ACTIVE session, admissions module ACTIVE; tokens signed directly (authenticate re-resolves roles/permissions from the membership, so a {userId,role,institutionId} token suffices); per-test clearAdmissions tears down child-first (application_reviews + student_profile_history + audit_events via scoped trigger-disable; audit/notifications deleted BEFORE applicant users to satisfy actorUserId/userId FKs). 15 tests, all pass:
- REGISTER (AC-16): PUBLIC /register (NO token) -> 201, creates User(role=STUDENT inert, ACTIVE) + ACTIVE InstitutionMembership + APPLICANT membership role + NO StudentProfile + admissions.applicant.registered audit; duplicate same-tenant email -> 409; unknown institution -> rejected (403 from the public module gate, or 404) with NO account; short password -> 400.
- AUTH GUARD unchanged: a tokenless GET /campaigns and POST /applications still -> 401 (proves the public-route fix did NOT over-expose the authenticated surface).
- OFFICER-ON-BEHALF: POST /applications by email creates applicant User + ACTIVE membership + APPLICANT role + NO StudentProfile; re-create same campaign+applicant -> 409 with the User REUSED (count stays 1).
- JOURNEY + ENROLL CREATE (AC-6): campaign->apply->document->submit->review(append-only)->UNDER_REVIEW->ELIGIBLE->offer->accept->enroll creates EXACTLY ONE StudentProfile (semester=1, program free-text = Program.name, programId set, departmentId from the program, academicSessionId = resolved intake session, status ENROLLED) + EXACTLY ONE Enrollment + CREATED/ENROLLED history rows + admissions.application.enrolled audit.
- HEADLINE ENROLL LINK (AC-7): a pre-existing APPLICANT-status StudentProfile for the SAME applicant User -> Enrollment LINKS to it (created:false, studentProfileId = the existing id), STILL EXACTLY ONE StudentProfile (no duplicate), flipped APPLICANT->ENROLLED.
- WRONG-PERSON (AC-17): an enrollmentNo owned by a DIFFERENT User (not sharing email) -> 409, applicant gets no profile, no Enrollment row, the other person's profile untouched.
- RE-ENROLL idempotency (AC-8): second enroll -> 409, still exactly 1 StudentProfile + 1 Enrollment.
- AC-5 REJECTED cannot enroll -> 409 (no profile). AC-4 illegal DRAFT->ELIGIBLE PATCH -> 409, status unchanged. AC-19 direct staff PATCH ->ACCEPTED -> 409 'ACCEPTED is set only by accepting an offer', status unchanged. AC-19 offer decline -> application back to ELIGIBLE + a replacement offer issues OK (->OFFERED). AC-18 enroll with no resolvable intake session (campaign intakeSessionId null + no body session) -> 422.
- AC-9 append-only review: a recorded ApplicationReview cannot be UPDATEd or DELETEd at the DB (REVOKE + trigger); AC-15 admissions.review.recorded audit written. AC-3 applicant ownership isolation: applicant two reading applicant one's application -> 404; GET /applications/mine returns only own. AC-10 module gating: with admissions SUSPENDED every operational route (GET /campaigns, GET /applications, POST /applications) -> 403, and the data survives re-activation.

ESCAPE SUITE EXTENSION: apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts + tenant-escape.integration.test.ts now cover ALL SIX new tables. RLS_TABLES += admission_campaigns, admission_campaign_programs, applications, application_documents, admission_offers, enrollments, application_reviews. EXPECTED_POLICIES += application_reviews: [tenant_isolation_select, application_reviews_tenant_insert] (append-only pair, NO modify) — the other five + the join fall through to DEFAULT_POLICIES (standard select+modify). SeededTenant/seedTenant/cleanup/countRemainingTestRows extended with the five mutable Phase-6 rows for tenants A+B (campaign targeting the seeded program/session -> join -> application ELIGIBLE -> document -> live ISSUED offer -> enrollment referencing the ALREADY-seeded studentProfile); application_reviews is NOT seeded in the shared setup (its trigger would block the shared teardown). New test block (3tt-3zz): read escape, spoofed-tenant insert, foreign-parent composite-FK (application->campaign, enrollment->studentProfile), spoofed update (count 0), buggy-query backstop, three-GUC-state fail-closed for the five mutable tables; PLUS a self-contained append-only case for application_reviews (insert OK; cross-tenant SELECT empty; UPDATE + DELETE denied; scoped trigger-disable cleanup via application_reviews_no_update_delete) modeled on the student_profile_history/schedule_revisions 3x case. Policy meta-test (case 6): all six tables asserted RLS enabled+forced with their expected policy sets, and application_reviews added to the append-only no-tenant_isolation_modify assertion list. tenant-escape suite = 60/60 in isolation.

PRODUCT FIX (approved via workflow, Option A): the new behavioral suite caught a real FEAT-003 bug — POST /api/admissions/register was NOT actually public. FEAT-003 declared /register BEFORE `app.addHook('preHandler', authenticate)`, but Fastify applies an addHook preHandler to EVERY route in the encapsulation context regardless of declaration order (verified with a minimal repro, flat and under app.register), so an unauthenticated applicant got 401 and could never register (AC-16 unmet). FIX in apps/api/src/routes/admissions.ts: the PUBLIC /register route stays on the outer (hook-free) instance; ALL authenticated routes were moved into an encapsulated child plugin `await app.register(async (app) => { app.addHook('preHandler', authenticate); ... })` so the hook covers only them. Behavior-preserving: every authenticated route keeps authenticate + per-route requirePermission + requireModuleActive('admissions') + withTenant + audit (the enclosing admissionsRoutes helpers are reachable by closure); the AUTH-GUARD-unchanged test proves tokenless authenticated routes still 401. Only /register changed (401 -> working 201 per design). npm run build -w @campusgate/api green; the fast suite stayed 382/382 (the mocked tier was unaffected).

HEADLINE no-duplicate-identity LINK proof: in the LINK test, after enroll of an application whose applicant already owns a StudentProfile, adminClient.studentProfile.count({ where: { userId: applicantUserId } }) === 1 AND the single Enrollment.studentProfileId === the pre-existing profile id (created:false) — no second StudentProfile row. The CREATE test independently proves exactly one StudentProfile + one Enrollment with the design §4 column sources; re-enroll and wrong-person both 409 with zero extra rows.
